LanguageData.RitualFilter_Help_Tooltip:
Entered text will be matched against pawn names.
Examples of more advanced uses: • h:preg ➤ pregnant pawns • a>12 ➤ pawns older than 12 • t:tough ➤ pawns with tough trait • ab:call ➤ pawns with abilities like Warcall • mining<10 ➤ pawns with mining skill lower than 10 • !p:melee ➤ pawns without melee passion
LanguageData.RitualFilter_Presets_FindWhere: You can configure filter presets in the mod settings.
LanguageData.RitualFilterModName_Presets_HowTo: Filters presets are separated by newlines. ⏎ Click the magnifying glass next to the filter in the ritual dialog to select a preset.
